content_zh:
次日一早, 苏檀揉着酸痛的身体, 挣扎着起床。
雪白的皮肤上青一块紫一块, 有种说不出的暧昧。
让她心惊的是, 这具身体并不是她的！
她记得她在山上发现一种新的草药, 为了研究药性, 亲自尝试, 却不幸中了毒。
谁知醒来就在这里了。
视线落在边上的男人身上，眉头皱得愈发紧了。
他眼睫深长、鼻梁高挺、嘴唇很薄，轮廓分明的侧脸十分英俊。
哪怕是闭着眼睛, 紧蹙的眉头也写满了生人勿进。
一旁散落的西装，每一个细节都叫嚣着金钱的味道。
还有他的腕表，价格不菲, 是很多人一辈子只能隔着橱窗打量的。
男人有钱已经够让人追逐, 何况他还英俊。
想到俩人昨晚的疯狂，苏檀不觉脸部发热, 理智很快回来, 她思考着眼前的一切。
对方的呼吸很不正常, 想到他昨夜冲动又不自制的反应, 可见是被人下了药。
而“她”也明显被人下药。
如此说来, 这一切远没有表面看的这样简单。
窗外传来朦胧的天光, 霞光透过没来得及拉上的薄纱，让苏檀足以窥测周围的情况。
这不是她熟悉的世界。
身边的男人她也不认识。
情况真遭。
不论如何，眼下要做的是赶紧离开这里。

“白薇, 你一大早把我带来酒店做什么？”
“陵游, 其实不是我不想告诉你，我是怕说出来你心里难受，虽然我知道你对她没感情，可她毕竟是你老婆，千不该万不该在婚内出轨，你说你好歹是封氏的大少爷，如果事情传出去，岂不是要变成别人的笑柄了？”
封陵游闻言，眉头紧锁。“你是说苏檀？她出轨？”
“是啊，不过我看她也不是那种人，陵游，你待会若是看到什么不该看的画面，千万别生气，应该听她辩解几句，说不定是有什么苦衷的。”
“苦衷！什么苦衷！”封陵游火冒三丈，“早知道她不是什么省心的！没想到这么不要脸！房间号多少！”
“2709！陵游，你别冲动，说不定是误会！”
然而，封陵游早已冲到门口，砰砰砰拍响房间大门。
躲在安全通道里的苏檀看着这一切，脑子一阵钝痛，记忆如潮水涌来。
她确实来到一个陌生的世界，这个世界和她之前的相差无几，可这个苏檀却确确实实不是她。
原身也叫苏檀，是眼前这个男人封陵游的妻子。
可笑的是，这个在边上煽风点火，恨不得天下大乱的女人白薇，正是封陵游的小三！
事情还真有趣，小三拉着她老公来捉她的奸！
豪门的生活真是精彩！
苏檀生怕给原身惹来麻烦，不敢再看下去，赶紧离开。
封陵游不耐地拍着门，“给我出来！我知道你在里面！把你的奸夫给我揪出来！”
沉沉的敲门声让床上的男人从睡梦中醒来，他打量着周围，眉头紧蹙。
他不时按压着太阳穴，以缓解宿醉后头部的不适。
屋外的敲门声一阵阵传来，连个间歇都没有，吵得人脑壳疼。
封京墨仅有的耐心几近极限。
门口的男人一直在骂：

“苏檀！赶紧开门！别以为我不知道你在里面！把你奸夫拉出来，我今天就是来捉奸的，我要看看这奸夫……”
门陡然拉开。
一脸阴沉的封京墨，面无表情地站在门里。
一旁的白薇却猛然兴奋起来，指着封京墨大喊：“陵游！看！这就是那个奸夫！走！咱们赶紧进去！苏檀那不要脸的肯定还在里面！”
看清男人的脸后她微怔片刻，这男人不是她安排的，事情是不是哪里出了错？她花钱请来的男人哪去了？不过不要紧，不管对方是谁，只要出轨这事板上钉钉，苏檀是无论如何也逃不过的！
她掏出手机对准封京墨摄像，嘴边露出得逞地笑：“视频拍下来，他们想赖也赖不掉！”
她拉了封陵游好几下，封陵游却呆愣在原地，动都不动。
封陵游满脸惊愕，没吐出口的话绕在舌尖，却怎么也说不出口。
“陵游，你怎么了？”白薇这才发觉他不对劲。“这就是苏檀的奸夫！你愣着干什么？”
封陵游的脸红一阵白一阵，他拉了拉白薇，讪笑：
“白薇，你认错人了，他不是奸夫。”
“怎么可能不是！我不可能搞错，就是这个房间，我明明亲眼……”白薇没出口的话陡然顿住。

content_en:
Early the next morning, Su Tan rubbed her sore body and struggled to get up.
There were patches of blue and purple on the snow-white skin, and there was an indescribable ambiguity.
What shocked her was that this body was not hers!
She remembered that she discovered a new herbal medicine in the mountains. In order to study its medicinal properties, she tried it herself, but unfortunately she was poisoned.
Who knew I would wake up here.
His eyes fell on the man beside him, and his brows furrowed even more tightly.
His eyelashes are deep and long, his nose is high, his lips are thin, and his chiseled profile is very handsome.
Even with his eyes closed, his frown was full of words saying "Don't let strangers in".
The suits scattered aside, every detail screams money.
And his watches are expensive, and many people can only look at them through the window in their lifetime.
A man's wealth is enough to make people chase him, not to mention he is handsome.
Thinking of the madness between the two of them last night, Su Tan felt her face heat up, and her rationality quickly returned. She thought about everything in front of her.
The other party's breathing was very abnormal. Considering his impulsive and uncontrollable reaction last night, it was obvious that he had been drugged.
And "she" was obviously drugged.
That being said, all this is far from as simple as it seems.
The hazy skylight came from the window, and the rays passed through the gauze that had not been closed in time, allowing Su Tan to have a glimpse of the surrounding situation.
This was not a world she was familiar with.
She didn't know the man next to her either.
What a bad situation.
No matter what, what we need to do now is to get out of here quickly.
"Bai Wei, why did you bring me to the hotel so early in the morning?"
"Ling You, it's not that I don't want to tell you. I'm afraid that you will feel uncomfortable if I tell you. Although I know that you have no feelings for her, she is your wife after all. She should never cheat on her during marriage. You said that you are the eldest son of the Feng family after all. If the matter spreads, won't you become the laughing stock of others?"
Feng Lingyou frowned when he heard this. "You mean Su Tan? She cheated?"
"Yes, but I don't think she is that kind of person. Ling You, if you see something you shouldn't see later, don't be angry. You should listen to her explanation. Maybe she has some reasons."
"The reason! What the reason!" Fengling You was furious, "I knew she was not a worry-free person! I didn't expect to be so shameless! What's the room number!"
"2709! Lingyou, don't be impulsive, it might be a misunderstanding!"
However, Fenglingyou had already rushed to the door and banged on the door of the room.
Su Tan, who was hiding in the safe passage, watched all this, his head felt a dull pain, and memories came flooding back.
She had indeed come to a strange world, which was almost the same as her previous one, but this Su Tan was indeed not her.
Her original name was also Su Tan, and she was the wife of the man in front of her, Feng Lingyou.
What's ridiculous is that Bai Wei, the woman who is fanning the flames and wanting the world to be in chaos, is Fenglingyou's mistress!
Things are really interesting, the mistress drags her husband along to catch her cheating!
The life of a wealthy family is really exciting!
Su Tan was afraid of causing trouble to the original person, so he didn't dare to look any further and left quickly.
Feng Lingyou patted the door impatiently, "Come out! I know you are in there! Find out your adulterer!"
A heavy knock on the door woke the man on the bed from his sleep. He looked around and frowned.
He pressed his temples from time to time to relieve the discomfort in his head after a hangover.
The knocks on the door outside the house came one after another without even a break, and it was so noisy that my head hurt.
Feng Jingmo's patience was almost at its limit.
The man at the door kept cursing:
"Su Tan! Open the door quickly! Don't think I don't know you are inside! Pull your adulterer out. I am here to catch the adulterer today. I want to see this adulterer..."
The door suddenly opened.
Feng Jingmo, with a gloomy face, stood in the door expressionlessly.
Bai Wei on the side suddenly became excited, pointed at Feng Jingmo and shouted:"Ling You! Look! This is the adulterer! Let's go in quickly! That shameless Su Tan must still be inside!"
After seeing the man's face clearly, she was stunned for a moment. This man was not arranged by her. Did something go wrong? Where is the man she paid for? But it doesn't matter, no matter who the other party is, as long as the affair is confirmed, Su Tan can't escape it no matter what!
She took out her mobile phone and pointed it at Feng Jingmo to take the video, with a triumphant smile on her lips: "If the video is captured, they will be able to rely on it even if they want!"
She pulled Feng Lingyou several times, but Feng Lingyou stayed in place, unable to move.
Feng Lingyou's face was filled with astonishment. The words he had not spoken out were on the tip of his tongue, but he couldn't say them out.
"Lingyou, what's wrong with you?" Bai Wei realized something was wrong with him. "This is Su Tan's adulterer! Why are you standing there stunned?"
Fengling's face turned red and white. He pulled Bai Wei and laughed:
"Bai Wei, you have recognized the wrong person. He is not an adulterer."
"How could it not be! I can't be mistaken. It's this room. I clearly saw it with my own eyes..." Bai Wei's unspoken words suddenly stopped.
